༄༅/ /rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga kun mkhyen rang byung yab sras kyi bzhed pa'i snying po bsdus pa rnam dag dgongs gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: 3!"#$%&'()*+,-./0123༄༅// rten gsum rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga kun mkhyen rang byung yab sras kyi bzhed pa'i snying po bsdus pa rnam dag dgongs gsal zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo gu ru shākya rā dza ya/ rab brtan ye shes rdo rje dam tshig gi /phyag rgya'i srog tu gzhug tshe bem pos kyang*// sangs rgyas phrin las lhun gyis grub mdzad pa// dngos kun khyab bdag gang des shis pa stsol// rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga mkhas rnams kyis// rgyas bsdus mang du mdzad mod rang mnyam gyis// lag tu len bde rgyud 'grel rtsa ba'i don// rang bzo med par 'chad la skyon yon min// rten gsum la sogs pa rnams gsang gsum phrin las dang bcas pa so so'i bdag nyid du lhag par rab tu gnas par sgrub pa la/ jo bo rjes/ don dam spros bral rab gnas dang*// kun rdzob sku gsung thugs kyi'o// zhes gsungs pa ltar gnyis las/ snga ma ni ye shes la dbang thob pa'i skyes bu chen po rnams kyis dgongs pa gtad pa tsam gyis/ ri brag sogs rang byung dang bcos pa'i rten gang yin kyang ye shes chen po'i 'khor lor byin gyis rlob nus pas cho ga la ma ltos shing*/ phyi ma ni/ rdo rje gur las/ rtag tu sangs rgyas rab gnas bya// zin pa'i de ma thag pa ru// rab tu gnas pa mchog tu 'gyur// ces gsungs pa'i don rgyud sde so so'i dgongs pa dang mthun pa'i cho ga tshad dang ldan pa rgyas 'bring bsdus pa gang rung gi bya dgos la/ de'ang gang la rab tu gnas pa'i rten chags tshad dang ldan pa/ gang gis rab gnas byed pa'i slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ ji ltar rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga'i tshul phyin ci ma log pa kho na gal che ste/ de dag tshad dang mi ldan pas ni 'phral yul kun tu nyes pa du ma skyed par byed la/ de las ldog pas thun mongs dang mchog gi dngos grub bde blag tu 'thob pa rdo rje 'chang nyid kyis yang yang gdams par mdzad pa ltar rgya bod kyi gzhung tshad ma rnams las rgyas bsdus lag len ci rigs 'byung ba las/ sgrub brgyud kaṃ tshang gi phyogs su thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i rab gnas bum gnyis ma kho na rtsa bar snang bas gzhung der mdo lugs dang sngags lugs gnyis su gsungs pa'i dang po ni/

rgyal tshab byams pa dang thogs med sku mched nas brgyud pa dpal ldan a ti sha'i gdams ngag jo bo bka' gdams pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes te/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod mi dgos shing rten rnams thub pa'i dbang por bskyed pa la mdo lugs zhes tha snyad du mdzad pa las/ bdag bum rten gyi bskyed chog yan lag bzhi tshang bar dgos pas don la rgyud sde 'og ma dang gtso bor 'brel pa thung mong ba'i lugs so// gnyis pa ni/ rgyud sde rnams las gsungs shing grub pa'i slob dpon so sos bkral ba ltar rgyud sde'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs shing rten rnams kyang der bskyed pa sogs sngags kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos dang ldan pa'o// de gnyis ka la'ang phyis su rgyas 'bring bsdus pa'i phyag len mang du spros par snang ba las/ 'dir nye bar mkho ba'i dbang gis bsdus pa dang shin tu bsdus pa'i lag len bshad par bya ste/ de'ang slob dpon a bhā yas/ mdor bsdus pa'i rab gnas bya ba ni/ sku gzugs la sogs pa stong pa nyid kyi rjes la skad cig gis de dang de'i dam tshig sems dpa' spyan dang sku la sogs pa byin gyis brlabs bskyed nas/ de la de'i ye shes sems dpa' rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis bkug pa bcug la/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od zer bkug pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa la sogs pa dang*/ rang gis kyang bum pa'i chus dbang bskur te mchod nas/ de'i sngags brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas so// zhes pas ni sku gzugs la sogs pa'i rab tu gnas par 'gyur ro// zhes gsungs pa rtsa bar bzung nas slob dpon rnams kyis phyag bzhes ci rigs mdzad pa las/ 'dir dpal rang byung zhabs kyi bzhed pa ltar 'chad pa la gnyis/ mdo lugs dang*/ sngags lugs so// dang po mdo lugs ltar na gsum/ sta gon/ dngos gzhi/ rjes kyi bya ba'o// dang po la gsum/ yo byad/ cho ga /rten gyi sta gon no// dang po ni/

gang la rab gnas bya ba'i rten gyi mdun tu stegs bu gtsang ma'i dbus su mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bdun pa la bkra shis rtags brgyad ri mor bris pas bskor ba'am/ stabs bder byed na tsa ka li mi bzhag par maṇ+ḍal tshom bu so bdun ma bkod kyang rung*/ de'i g.yas su bum gdan pad+ma 'dab brgyad dam tshom bu'i khar rnam rgyal bum pa mgul chings ser po bzang shing gi kha rgyan gyi gseb tu dung chos 'o mas bkang ba gzungs rdor dang bcas pa/ nang du dri bzang gi chu dang nyer lnga'i rdzas kyis bkang ba bzhag /g.yon phyogs su las bum bcud ldan mgul chings ljang gu can/ mdun tu chu gnyis nyer spyod phreng tshar/ tsāru'i bza' ba dkar gsum gyi zhal zas ci 'byor/ phyogs gcig tu chos skyong gi gtor ma dmar gtor rgyan ldan gcig /'thor nas 'bru dkar bzang po/ me long sku phyi na bza' sogs khrus kyi chas/ gu gul/ yungs kar/ dri bzang gi chu snod/ sbyong gtor/ til nag sogs nye bar mkho ba rnams tshogs par bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs sogs kyis skyabs sems lan gsum sngon tu song nas/ dpon slob thams cad kyis don zhags las 'byung ba'i theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong len par grub na lugs 'dir dmigs su gsungs pas shin tu legs so// gang ltar slob dpon nyid bsnyen sogs las su rung ba'i yi dam bdag bskyed bsdus pa zhig bsgoms la bzlas pa cung zad bya'o// de'ang da lta'i tshul dang mthun pa la bde phag rgyal rgyam mi 'khrugs pa sgrol dkar lta bu gang byed kyang khyad par med cing*/ bde mchog la mtshon na kun mkhyen bstan pa'i nyin byed kyis mdzad pa'i lhan skyes sgom bzlas tsam bya zhing*/ bzlas pa grub ma thag par bum bskyed la 'jug pa las bsdu stangs lugs 'dir ma gsungs so// de nas rnam rgyal bum pa hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags kyis bsang*/ swa bhas sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+ruṃ las rin po che'i bum pa gzhal yas khang gi ngo bo'i dbus su rin po che'i dri dang pad+ma'i steng du oṃ ye dharma he tu pra bha ba he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥswā hā/

gser gyi kha dog can las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ mtshan sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cus brgyan pa/ sa gnon mnyam bzhag gi phyag rgya can/ chos gos rnam pa gsum gyis klubs pa/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du rten 'brel snying po 'od dang bcas pa de las 'od 'phros sangs rgyas thams cad spyan drangs par gyur/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ pra tī ts+tsha swā hā/ pād+yaṃ/ puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ ā lo ke/ gan+dhe/ nai wid+ya/ shab+da/ rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba// ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra// grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lhang nge ba// mgon po mchog gyur rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod// dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ bdag nyid lha'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi 'od zer byung*/ gzungs thag la brgyud/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs kyi rgyud bskul/ rten 'brel snying po las bdud rtsi dkar po babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ gzungs thag 'dus la/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharma ya/ na mo saṅgha ya/ oṃ ye dharmā sogs rten snying ci 'grub bzlas pa'i mthar/ oṃ badz+ra satwa hūm̐ gis dung zhal phul bas/ bum pa'i lha bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun tu gyur/ las bum mi dmigs pa stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du rin po che'i bum pa'i dbus su/ pad nyi la hūm̐ las khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang sngon g.yas rdo rje'i dbyug pa dang*/ g.yon sdigs mdzub can khro bo'i chas dang ldan pa zhabs brkyang bskum gyis bzhengs pa'i gnas gsum du oṃ ā hūm̐/ thugs kar hūm̐ la sngags kyis bskor ba'i 'od kyis ye shes pa spyan drangs/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe hoḥ

gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang hūm̐ gi 'od kyis rigs lnga spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes dbang bskur bas dri ma dag te don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las khro bo'i rang bzhin gyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra amṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa lī ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ci 'grub dang*/ khrus kyi don tu/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ zhes pa'ang ci 'grub bzla/ mthar/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pas rab tu gnas pa'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du bgegs zlog pa dang bar chad srung ba'i phrin las mdzod cig / me tog la/ 'bru rnams rten 'brel snying po'i yig 'bru'i rang bzhin gser btso ma'i kha dog tu gyur/ na mo bud+dhā ya sogs ye dhar chen mo ci rigs bzla/ dri sku gsung thugs ye shes rdo rje'i bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bzla/ yungs kar khro bo dang khro chung gi sprin dpag tu med par gyur/ zhes gul yungs la hūm̐ bzhi dang a mṛ ta bzla bas byin brlab bo// gsum pa ni/ bgegs sbyong ba ni/ gtor ma cog ldog gsum po rten la bskor zhing*/ sarba bighā na na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+phar ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ni daṃ ba l+yā dī swā hā/ zhes gsum dang*/ rten rab tu gnas pa la bar du gcod pa'i gdon bgegs zhi bas sbyang bar 'os pa thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la gnas gzhan du song zhig / zhes gtor ma snod du spungs te gnas bsags/ ting lo chang bu bskor cing*/ sngags snga mas bsngos/ suṃ bha ni sa bskrad pa lan gsum mthar/ zhi drag phyed mas sbyang bar 'os pa zhes brjod mthar/ gal te mi 'gro ba de dag rdo rje'i me lces rlag par 'gyur ro// zhes brjod la gtor ma phyir btang*/ rang nyid skad cig gis rdo rje khro bo'i skur gyur ba'i thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs par gyur/

'dir spro na ye shes bskal pa sogs tshang bar brjod/ dkyus su/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pā ri bā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sngags de la ar+ghaṃ sogs btags pas mchod/ hūm̐/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrog cing*// bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa// dngos grub ma lus stsol pa'i lha// bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pa tsam gyis bstod nas/ hūm̐/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i sa gzhi la gnas pa'i// lha la sogs pa'i bgegs tshogs kun nyon cig /nga ni gnas 'dir rab tu gnas pa sgrub// khyod rnams 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// gal te nga yi bka' las 'da' byed na// ye shes can gyi rdo rje 'bar ba yis// mgo bo tshal pa brgyar ni 'gems 'gyur zhing*// bgegs rnams brlag par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// zhes bsgos te a mṛ ta dang hūm̐ bzhi pa'i drag sngags yungs thun sogs kyis bskrad/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum/ bdag dang gnas dang rnal 'byor bsrung bar gyur/ zhes bsrung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms la mtshams bcing ngo*// byur bsal ba ni/ bdag dang sbyin bdag rten gyi snying gar kaṃ las sdig sgrib kyi ngo bo sdig pa'i gzugs su gyur ba lte ba nas hūm̐ las rdo rje gnod sbyin du gyur pas sna sgo'i lam nas ded cing mdun gyi til la thim par gyur/ til me chur dor la/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha trai lo kya bi dza ya kha kha khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ da ha na bha smin ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ lan gsum mthar/ g.yas su ye shes kyi mer bsregs/ g.yon tu rgya mtsho chen por dor bas byang zhing dag par gyur/ zhes kyang brjod de phyir dor ro// de nas bkru zhing phyi ba ni me long khrus dar dang*/ las bum thogs la/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba kha lo bsgyur ba bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das la bdag gis yo byad thams cad dang ldan pa'i khrus 'di gsol bar bgyi'o//

zhes snyan mnan/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher ba bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang kun gyi sku// gser sbyangs gtso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// auṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/ zhes dri'i 'dag chal byugs/ khro chen bdud rtsi 'khyil pa yis// byin rlabs ye shes chu yis ni// rgyal ba'i sku la khrus gsol bas// sgrib pa'i tshogs rnams dag gyur cig /oṃ a mṛ ta sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis khrus gsol lo// oṃ sarba ta thā sogs sngags/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin rlabs ye shes chu yin te// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod// sngags/ rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyang slad du// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa dag gyur cig /na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta bi sho dha ni hūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chu// yid 'ong legs par gang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// nyin mo bde legs sogs dang sngags brjod la khrus gsol/ rgyal dang rgyal ba'i sras kyi sku rnams la// ras dkar sman dang ldan pas sku phyis pas// mi shes sgrib pa ma lus kun bsal nas// nyes pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥkā ya bi sho dha ni swā hā/

zhes khrus ras kyis phyi/ gos zung thogs la/ srab 'jam yang pa lha yi gos// mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku brnyes la// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra āḥhūm̐/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// gang la reg na bde ba'i rgyur gyur pa// gos bzang rin chen bdag blo sbyong phyir 'bul// bzod pa dam pa'i gos kyis brgyan par shog / sngags bcas kyis 'bul lo// gnyis pa cho ga'i dngos gzhi la gsum/ rten sgrub pa/ rab tu gnas pa/ mnga' dbul ba'o// dang po la rten bskyed pa ni/ bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri'i steng du paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du/ ye dharma he tu pra bha ba he tun+te ṣān+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro dha e waṃ bā dī ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ

zhes brjod cing*/ sngags phreng 'od dang bcas pa g.yas skor du 'khor ba de las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam bzhag gi steng na lhung bzed bsnams pa/ chos gos ngur smrig gsol ba/ dbu la gtsug tor dang zhabs la 'khor lo sogs mtshan dpes brgyan pa'i thugs kar zla ba'i steng du/ ye dharmā nas shra ma ṇaḥ 'i bar brjod/ ces pa'i sngags 'od dang bcas g.yas bskor du 'khor ba de las 'od 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs/ mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur/ spos dang rol mo bcas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzod 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur ba// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// ji ltar sangs rgyas rnams ni dga' ldan nas// sprul pa dam pa tog dkar lha yi bu// mi pham mgon la rgyal tshab dbang bskur nas// gzigs pa rnam lngas 'dzam bu'i gling gzigs shing*// glang chen thal dkar ltar gshegs lhums zhugs bzhin// rdo rje rin chen pad+ma'i rigs mchog dang*// las kyi rigs dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams// dus 'dir bdag gis dad pas spyan 'dren na// rten mchog 'di la 'byon par mdzad du gsol// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sa ma ya dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ bcom ldan khyod ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gis mchod yon bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni bzhugs su gsol// stong gsum kun dang mnyam pa yi// pad+ma 'dab brgyad ge sar bcas// bde zhing yangs par 'bul legs na// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol// pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ/

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod la/ snyan gsan dbab pa ni/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na bzhugs pa rnams dgongs su gsol/ sems can thams cad phan pa dang bde ba'i don gyi phyir dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i don tu rab tu gnas pa bgyid par 'tshal na 'dus pa thams cad byin gyis brlabs pa dang da ltar rten 'di la 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ zhes brjod la me tog 'thor zhing rol mo bsgrag /'di dag gi skabs su me tog ni byin rlabs ma byas pa'i 'bru 'thor dgos/ de nas gsol ba gdab pa ni/ 'di ltar bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa bde bar gshegs pa 'jig rten mkhyen pa skyes bu 'dul ba kha lo bsgyur ba/ bla na med pa lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das skyes bu chen po'i mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ yon tan thams cad kyis mnga' bdag rdo rje'i rigs dang*/ rin po che'i rigs dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs dang*/ las kyi rigs dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams mtha' yas mu med pa na bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams 'gro ba lha dang bcas pa la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir rten 'di rnams la 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ zhes me tog 'thor zhing rol chen dang bcas pa lan gsum du brjod pa'i tha ma la/ byon nas kyang brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ zhes brjod la nam mkha' bzhugs pa'i ye shes pa rnams rten la thim par mos/ de nas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te shā kya mu na ye*/ ta thā ga tā ya ar+ha te samyak+saṃ bud+dhā ya/ tād+ya thā/ oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā/

zhes ci rigs su bzla zhing byams pa dang snying rje byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgoms la rten dang don dam gyi ye shes dbyer med la ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag go /de nas/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa rnams 'bru dang tha dad med par byon nas rten so so la thim pas gnyis su med par gyur/ oṃ na mo bud+dhā ya/ sogs ye dhar chen mo brjod cing byin gyis brlabs pa'i me tog gi char dbab/ rol mo bsgrags la/ phun sum tshogs pa sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi shis brjod bya/ de nas rnam rgyal bum pa thogs la/ bdag dang bcom ldan 'das kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs dam gyi rgyud bskul/ de rnams kyis rin po che'i bum pa phyag tu thogs nas byon te dbang bskur bar gyur/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas/ sa ma ye shrī hūm̐/ zhes brjod la bum chu 'thor/ rten dngos sam me long du shar ba la/ dri'i chus gnas gsum du reg ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs dang dbyer med par gyur/ gser gyi thur ma thogs la spyan dbye tshul bya zhing*/ kun mkhyen ye shes spyan ldan skyon bral yang*// gus pas 'phags pa'i spyan ni dbye bgyis pas// nam mkha'i mthas gtugs gyur pa'i sems can rnams// sangs rgyas ye shes spyan ni thob par shog /oṃ tsak+ṣuḥtsak+ṣuḥs man+ta tsak+ṣuḥbi sho dha ni swā hā/ shes bya thams cad la gzigs pa'i spyan phun sum tshogs pa mnga' zhing sbyin bdag la zhi bas gzigs pa lhur len par gyur/ gnyis pa ni/ slon dpon gyi rdo rjes zhal reg cing*/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa ma thob kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/

bye brag tu rten 'di rnams 'byung ba chen po bzhi'i gnod pas zhig par ma gyur gyi bar du sems can gyi don du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams rten 'di rnams la brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod la rten zhal bsgyur ba ni/ mgon po skal pa ji bzhin du// sna tshogs gzugs ni bzung nas kyang*// phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten khams kun tu// des ni 'gro ba'i don kun mdzod// bcom ldan 'das thub pa chen po 'od du zhu ba las sku gsung thugs kyi rten so so'i rnam par gyur/ gsum pa la gnyis/ spyir mchod rten gyis mnga' dbul ba dang*/ bye brag rdzas kyi mnga' dbul ba'o// dang po ni/ mchod pa rnams slar kha gso la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi byin gyis brlabs pa'i stobs dang*/ bdag gi bsod nams dang smon lam gyi stobs dang*/ rig sngags kyi stobs kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor rnams la mchog tu rgya chen po byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i spyod pa las mngon par mtho ba'i mchod pa'i sprin chen po rab tu 'phro bar gyur cig /na maḥsarba bud+dha bodhi sa twa nāṃ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ sa man+ta swā hā/ lan brgyad kyis byin brlab/ 'jig rten khams ni dpag med na// mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*// bdag gis gus pas bshams pa 'di// rgyal ba sras dang bcas rnams mchod// na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ de bzhin tu/ mchod yon/ ces dang*/ ar+ghaṃ zhes pa'i gnas su/ zhabs bsil/ pād+yaṃ/ me tog /puṣ+pe/ bdug spos/ dhū pe/ snang gsal/ ā lo ke/ dri chab/ gan+dhe/ zhal zas/ nai bid+ya/ sgra snyan/ shab+da/ zhes sbyar bas phyi mchod 'bul/ phyogs dus kun na gzugs sgra dri dang ro// reg bya'i khyad par dbang po tshims byed rnams// mos blos rgyal ba sras bcas la 'bul na// bzhes nas bla med grub mchog stsal du gsol// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta rū pa shab+da gan+dhe ra sa spar+she kā ma gu ṇa badz+ra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ swā hā/

zhes 'dod yon lnga 'bul/ spro na sgeg sogs lha mo brgyad kyis kyang mchod la/ de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yi 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa'i// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig /dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang*// mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la// rin chen me tog la sogs char// rgyun mi chad pa 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas// rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa// de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs// mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod// bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la// nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig / ces brjod/ bstod pa ni/ dkon mchog rjes dran nam/ mnyam med mi g.yo sogs brjod kyang legs mod kyi/ bsdu na/ rgyal ba zla ba dri ma med pa'i sku// rgyal ba nyi ma 'od zer stong gi 'od// rgyal ba pad+ma dri ma med pa'i spyan// rgyal ba me tog pad rtsa rdul med tshems// rgyal ba'i yon tan rgya mtsho lta bu ste// rin po che ni du ma'i 'byung gnas gyur// rgyal ba rgya mtsho ye shes chu yis gang*// ting 'dzin brgya phrag stong gis kun tu gang*// rgyal ba'i zhabs ni 'khor los bres pa ste// 'khor yug mu khyud de bzhin rtsibs ma stong*// phyag dang zhabs ni drwa bas spras pa ste// zhabs kyi drwa ba ngang pa'i dbang po bzhin// gser gyi ri bo lta bur rab tu gda'// rgyal ba dri med gser gyi ri dbang po// yon tan thams cad ri dbang 'dra ba ste// sangs rgyas ri dbang rgyal la phyag 'tshal lo// de bzhin gshegs pa zla ba chu zla 'dra// nam mkha' dang yang mtshungs shing 'dra ba ste// sgyu ma smig rgyu lta bur chags med pa// rgyal ba dri ma med la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces brjod/ gnyis pa bye brag rdzas kyis mnga' dbul ba ni/

gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa'i ri bo/ khrus chab/ na bza'/ rgyal srid bdun/ 'phan gdugs sogs bkra shis rtags rdzas/ 'dod yon lnga/ lnga phrag lnga/ seng ge'i khri rnams rim par phul la/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ sna tshogs dbang po'i gzhu ltar rab bkra zhing*// sogs dang*/ oṃ badz+ra was+t+ra āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ mi dbang rin chen sna bdun 'di dag ni// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa ma lus la// bshams shing yid kyis sprul te phul ba yis// 'gro ba mi zad gter la spyod par shog /oṃ sap+ta ma hā rat+na pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ theg mchog bla bre gdugs dang ba dan dang*// bdud bcom rgyal mtshan lhab lhub ting 'dzin 'phan// gar dang rol mo mchod pa'i sgra dbyangs kyis// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor mdzes par brgyan par bgyi// oṃ badz+ra ma hā pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal nas// bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar// rgyal ba rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' la// bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bgyi// 'jig rten khyim bdag rnams ni dpal bstan nas// bil ba star kha bum pa bzang dang bcas// mdun du bdar nas bkra shis byed pa ltar// rgyal ba sras dang bcas la 'bul bar bgyi// oṃ aṣ+ṭa mam̐ ga la pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ gzugs sgra dri ro reg ldan pa'i// mchog tu gyur pa'i longs spyod rnams// bdag gis dad pas 'bul bar bgyi// ci bde bar ni bzhes su gsol// oṃ badz+ra pañtsa kā ma gu ṇa pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rgyal ba mgon po dpal gyis lham mer bzhugs// bsod nams ye shes sku lnga brnyes pa la// lnga phrag lnga ldan snying po dam pa 'bul// 'gro bas bde gshegs snying po thob par shog

/oṃ badz+ra pañtsa pañtsa bi ma la pū dza me gha āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ rin chen du ma las grub seng ge'i khri// yid 'phrog sna tshogs gos kyis bkab pa 'di// spros bral rgyal ba rnams la phul ba yis// 'gro kun rdo rje'i gdan la bzhugs par shog /oṃ badz+ra singha ā sa na āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ tsa ru'i bza' ba/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba thā khaṃ ut+gate s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na kham̐ swā hā/ zhes byin gyis brlabs la/ zhal zas ro brgya ldan pa yid 'phrog pa// legs sbyar 'di ni rgyal ba sras bcas la// dad pas phul bas 'gro ba'i 'di dag kun// 'byor ldan ting 'dzin zas la spyod par shog /oṃ badz+ra dībya an+ne sa mā dhi dh+yā na praṇā ne āḥhūm̐ swā hā/ zhes 'bul lo// sngags kyi mnga' dbul ni/ slob dpon gyis rdo rjes rten la reg pa'am gzungs thag btags pa'i sne bzung*/ thams cad kyis me tog 'thor la/ na mo bud+dhā ya sogs ye dhar chen mo dang*/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā dang*/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥbh+rūm̐ kham̐ badz+rī bha wa dṛḍhatiṣ+ṭha bhū khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pa rnams la re re zhing nyer gcig gam bdun tsam bzlas nas bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ji ltar rigs pa'ang brjod do// gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba la/ gtor ma gtang ba ni/ grub na dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyir rol du cha gsum gtor ma btang*/ de nas ma mgon lcam dral dang rnam thos sras la sogs pa la gtor chog mdor bsdus pas gtor ma bsngo ste 'dir mtshon na/ ma dag snod bcud sogs kyis gtor ma btang ba'i rjes su/ gta' gtor btegs la/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma khyed rnams kyis rab tu gnas par byas pa'i rten 'di rnams kyi yon bdag gyis la phyi ma'i mu mthar thug gi bar du srungs shig skyobs shig phrin las spel cig / ces brjod pa'i mthar rol chen dang bcas te gta' gtor rten gyi drung du de nyid la phyogs pas bzhag

/de nas mchod cing bzod par gsol ba ni/ mchod pa bzang du bshams la/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*// sogs bzang spyod las gsung pa'i mchod pa'i yan lag gi tshig bcad gsum gyis mchod/ yig brgya lan gsum dang*/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang de yi sras// tshangs sogs lha yi tshogs rnams kyis// gang dag cho ga bya ba la// 'gal zhing 'khrul pa gang mchis dang*// ma tshang ba dang lhag pa rnams// nongs par gyur pa gang lags te// kun tu bzod par mdzad du gsol// sbyin bdag bsgo ba dang de'i shis brjod sogs ni bsdus pa'i skabs 'dir ma gsungs la gal te spro bar 'dod na gzhan dang mthun no// de nas slob dpon la ci 'byor pa'i yon 'bul ba sogs dga' ston bya zhing*/ des kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba bla na med pa'i byang chub tu bsngo/ rjes shis pa brjod pa ni/ ston mchog dam pa sogs sngon tu 'gro ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa rgyas par brjod cing me tog 'thor ba dang rol mo'i sgra bsgrag go /de ltar bsdus pa'i cho ga dag kyang mi 'grub pas ni rje dgu pas mdzad pa'i rab gnas bsdus pa rigs gnyis sam/ yang na rtsa ba'i dgongs pa bslad med ltar sems bskyed la rang yi dam du skad cig gis gsal/ drag sngags kyis bgegs bskrad/

swā bhā bas rten sbyangs la thub pa'i dbang por bskyed/ sku gsung thugs byin brlab/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa thams cad rten 'di rnams la 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab la/ ye dharmā brjod cing me tog 'thor/ gsol gdab kyi gsham/ rten 'di rnams la brtan par bzhugs su gsol// zhes dang*/ su pra tiṣ+ṭha brjod la zhal bsgyur/ mchod bstod mdor bsdus kyis mnga' dbul zhing bkra shis brjod pas 'grub bo// gnyis pa sngags lugs kyi rab gnas bsdus pa ni/ dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang 'brel na bsham bkod kyi spros pa'ang so so'i lugs bzhin la/ rab gnas kyi yo byad ni sngar dang mtshungs/ thog mar bdag mdun bum pa sgrub cing bdag nyid 'jug pa sogs grub pa dang*/ dri dang me tog sogs byin rlabs la sbyang khrus bya/ rten rnams dkyil 'khor gang yin gyi lha der bskyed/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab so so'i lugs bzhin bya/ mchod bstod kyang de mtshungs dang tsā ru'i bza' ba'i skabs gtor 'bul dang tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya/ rjes chog gong smos grub nas slar dkyil 'khor gyi rjes chog rnams bya/ gzhan gong du smos pa ltar ro// dkyil 'khor sgrub mchod dang ma 'brel ba'i shin tu bsdus par 'dod na/ rnam rgyal bum pa mgul chings dkar po/ kha rgyan ku sha sogs gzug /bdag bskyed gang la brten pa'i gtor 'bul spro na gtor ma 'du bya/ yo byad gzhan gong dang mtshungs/ gso sbyong mi dgos pas/ thog mar skyabs sems nas brtsams bdag gi rnal 'byor bzlas pa bcas bya/ de nas rnam bum bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pad zla'i steng du bum las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang gzhal yas khang du gyur pa'i dbus su pad zla'i gdan la hūm̐ dkar po las 'od 'phros don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje sems dpa' dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i nyams can dar dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/

g.yas rdo rje thugs kar gtod cing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ zhabs sems skyil gyis bzhugs pa'i gnas gsum 'bru gsum gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ rang 'dra'i ye shes pa spyan drangs badz+ra sa mā dza/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ slar yang dbang lha 'khor bcas spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis lha la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas dbang lha rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsungs shing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag /chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbu brgyan par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas/ shab+da pra tī ts+tsha swā hā mchod/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che// rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun// rdo rje dang po kun tu bzang*// phyag 'tshal rdo rje sems dpa' la'o// zhes bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i 'od zer gzungs thag las brgyud de bum lha'i thugs kar phog pas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab/ bum pa gang bar gyur/ zhes mos la yig brgya dang yang snying ci 'grub bzla/ mthar 'od zhu dang*/ las bum sgrub pa/ dri sogs byin rlabs/ sbyong khrus sogs gong du bshad pa ltar la/ rten bskyed pa'i skabs su slob dpon kun dga' snying pos/ rdo rje slob dpon gang zhig la// mtshan mi shes pa'i lha rnams ni// rab tu gnas par byed pa na// the tshom gyur pas bzhag bya min// de bzhin gshegs kun thams cad kyi// thugs kyi ngo bo rdo rje sems// yin pas 'gal bar mi 'gyur phyir// rdo rje sems dpas rab gnas bya'o// zhes gsungs pas/ thams cad rdor sems gong smos ltar bskyed kyang shin tu rung mod kyi/ rigs lnga so sor bskyed par spro na/ rten bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las sku rten dang mchod rten gtsug lag khang la sogs pa seng ge'i btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam snang dkar po g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/

spyan ma dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ de bzhin du/ glegs bam rnams rma byas btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma dang nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du oṃ las pad+ma aṃ gis mtshan pa las snang ba mtha' yas dmar po g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ gos dkar mo dmar mo/ g.yas pad+ma dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ phyag mtshan rnams glang pos btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las mi bskyod pa sngon po g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ dbyings phyug ma sngon mo g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ bang mdzod dang rin po che'i rigs rnams rta mchog gis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du swā las rin po che swās mtshan pa las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po g.yas rin po che dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ mā ma ki ser mo g.yas rin po che dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rol mo go cha srung ba'i rigs rnams shang shang gis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs pad+ma nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng du hā las rgya gram hā sa mtshan pa las don yod grub pa ljang gu g.yas rgya gram dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu g.yas rgya gram dang g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ thams cad kyang zhi zhing 'dzum la mtshan dpe'i lang tsho rab tu rgyas pa dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing 'od zer mtha' yas par spro ba'i bdag nyid can du bzhugs pa'o// de rnams kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par ā dmar po/

thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po rnams kyis mtshan par bsam mo// bdag dang rten gyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas ye shes kyi 'khor lo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshogs thams cad oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de nas spyan drangs pa sogs sngar ltar la/ snying po yig brgya bzla/ dbang bskur ba'i skabs/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las byung ba'i 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga sras dang bcas pa badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ spyan drangs nas mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas mchod/ chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces bstod nas/ rdo rje can gyi sangs rgyas la// 'gro ba skyob pa'i ched du dbang*// yon tan 'byung gnas ji ltar stsal// de ltar 'di la'ang stsal du gsol// zhes gsol ba btab pas nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ yum rnams kyi bum pa'i chu rgyun gyis dbang bskur/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis pa'i glu dbyangs brjod/ lha mo rnams kyis gdugs dang ba dan la sogs pa bsgrengs zhing*/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas mchod rdzas kyi char 'bebs/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad pa'i las mdzad par bsam/ bkra shis gang zhig sems can kun gyi snying la gnas// kun gyi bdag nyid rigs kun gyi ni bdag po mchog /ma lus sems can skyed mdzad bde ba chen po ste*// des ni deng khyod dbang bskur mchog la bkra shis shog / ces dang*/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// sogs dang*/ de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bas sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi bor 'khyil pa las rnam snang sogs bdag por gyur ba'i rigs lngas dbu brgyan par

bsam/ oṃ hūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ.āḥ pañtsa ku la muku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ zhes dbu rgyan gyis dbang bskur/ oṃ hūm̐/ zhes go bsgos/ oṃ tuṣ+ya hoḥ/ zhes rdo rje thal mos mnyes par bya// bstod pa nges par mnyam med mas bstod// tshogs dang gtor 'bul spro na tsā ru'i bza' ba'i gong du bya/ mi spro na nges par dgos pa ma yin/ rjes bdag bskyed bsdu ldang sogs bya'o// de las kyang bsdu na/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro ba'i las bum bsgrub/ sbyong khrus nas brtsams rten bsgyur ba'i bar sngar bzhin la/ mchod bstod tsam dang sngags kyis mnga' dbul/ rjes mchod pa bzod gsol bsngo smon shis brjod dang*/ bdag bskyed kyi rjes chog byas pas 'grub bo// shin tu bsdu na/ bdag nyid skad cig gis rdo rje khro bo'i skur gyur/ drag sngags brjod cing bgegs bskrad/ rten bskyed/ spyan drangs/ dam ye bsre/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab/ spyan dbye/ zhal bsgyur la brtan bzhugs kyi gsol ba gdab la 'bru 'thor/ mchod bstod kyis mnga' dbul/ bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa gang 'os grub bo// bden gnyis dbyer med rab tu gnas pa'i tshul// rgya bod mkhas pa'i gzhung lugs bye ba'i bcud// rang byung rgyal ba gnyis pa'i dgongs don la// rang bzos ma bslad 'jug bde legs par bshad// kun rdzob rten la don dam ye shes kyi// snying po 'bral ba med par rtag 'azhugs nas// mngon par mtho dang nges par legs pa yi// bkra shis rgya mtsho'i smin chen bkod gyur cig// /ces pa'ang kun mkhyen bla ma 'jam mgon dgyes pa'i zhabs kyis bka'i gnang ba bstsal ba dang*/ rang gzhan la phan par 'dod pa'i bsam pas karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtshos dpal spungs yang khro kun bzang bde chen 'od gsal gling du rgyal ba lha las babs pa'i dkar phyogs kyi tshes bzang por sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//
